title: Effect of the proposed Cooper River rediversion and sedimentation in Charleston Harbor, South Carolina
citation: Patterson, G.G., 1983, Effect of the proposed Cooper River rediversion and sedimentation in Charleston Harbor, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Resources Investigations Report 83-4198, map scale 1:645,000.
notes:
Sediment-budget report for Charleston Harbor; mostly dredging, discharge and sediment-load figures, which are not geologic units, observations or aquifers and were not recorded. Recorded the harbor bottom sediment (glossary and composition) and the one named formation mentioned (Cooper Marl, as the probable source of coccoliths). Appendix A (pp. 42-54) is daily discharge/sediment records for gaging station 02172001 (Lake Moultrie tailrace), not recorded. Skipped general non-SC references (Guilcher, Hubbell, Inglis, Meade 1972/1976, Odum, Postma, Pritchard, Schubel, Shultz, Simmons, Stamer, USACE 1973, U.S. Congress, USGS data reports) and USACE 1963, 1966b, 1966c, 1966e. Note: catalog title says 'rediversion and sedimentation' but the report title reads 'rediversion on sedimentation'; catalog kind 'map' though this is a text report.
Pages 55-70 are appendices A (continued) and B: daily discharge and suspended-sediment records for stations 02172001 (Lake Moultrie tailrace near Pinopolis) and 02169800 (Santee River near Fort Motte). No geologic units, observations, structures, aquifers or references; nothing recorded.
